title: How to choose the next safe step in application modernization
author: Sam Quakenbush
description: Learn how to assess a legacy application, choose a bounded modernization step, and reuse the method with a GitHub Copilot agent skill. The post How to choose the next safe step in application modernization appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: A request to modernize an application often starts with a technology question: Which framework should replace the old one? Before you choose, find out what still works.
takeaways: It also shows how to encode the procedure in a GitHub Copilot agent skill while keeping architectural judgment with the people responsible for the system.
I used an evidence-first method on four public applications, from a small Node.js game to a large Java enterprise resource planning (ERP) application.
“Java microservices” doesn’t tell you which Java Development Kit (JDK) runs in production, where that version is pinned, whether the tests execute, or which interfaces other systems depend on.
